text: せんせいに　また　えを　おしえて　もらってるの

structure.jp: また　えを　おしえて　もらってるの

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえて　もらってる
patterns.explanation: てもらう after a verb says someone does it for you; the person doing it gets に. おしえて　もらってる = 'I'm having (my teacher) teach me'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which shows something going on now. もらってる = 'am getting'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence gives a soft explaining tone, often used by girls and children. もらってるの = 'I'm getting it, you see'.
